title: Natural finite-level affine completion quotients
statement: Let X be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], I a quasi-coherent ideal, U an affine open with Noetherian open subscheme, and rho a functor on coherent formal modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] whose underlying systems equal restriction along U. Put A=Gamma(X,U), J=I(U), and T_G equal the affine section tower of rho(completion G). For every coherent G and n there is an A-linear equivalence theta_G,n: Gamma(G,U)/J^(n+1)Gamma(G,U) -> T_G(n), commuting with every quotient reduction n<=m and every coherent map G->H. No inverse-limit comparison or reflection assertion is included.

source.place: Lemma 0881, affine identification in its proof; finite-level part of steps 3-4 of the natural affine comparison

proof.text: The unit of open restriction/pushforward is an isomorphism after evaluation on U: its section map is restriction from U to itself. Whisker this natural isomorphism on inverse systems and combine with eqToIso hρ to obtain a natural isomorphism between the original completion section tower and T.

Coherence implies quasi-coherence. Apply the existing proved private theorem AlgebraicGeometry.quotient_affine from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentMapReductionTorsionKernel, made available by a proof-only import all, to obtain surjectivity and the ideal-power kernel formula at each positive level. Compose quotEquivOfEq with quotKerEquivOfSurjective and then the component of the tower isomorphism to construct theta. The reduction-torsion theorem itself is not applied.

For both transition and coherent-map naturality, lift a quotient class along mkQ_surjective. On representatives the quotient equivalence equals the original quotient projection. Naturality of the tower isomorphism and the cokernel π_desc equation reduce both composites to the same map. This is the compiled proof, with no new holes.

mathlib_searches.query: Coherent formal modules on an affine scheme are reconstructed fully faithfully from inverse limits of sections
The inverse limit functor from coherent adic systems on an affine scheme to modules is fully faithful
mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget and Scheme.Modules.fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules concern forgetful functors, not section limits; no exact match.

General fully faithful functors reflect limits; LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective constructs quotient equivalences. No formal affine section-limit theorem. Local source search found Scheme.Modules.exists_hom_app_top_eq_of_isAffine, hom_ext_of_isAffine and the affine formal projection theorem; these supply the route for the remaining lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem formalCompletion_affine_quotients
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (U : X.Opens) [IsNoetherian U.toScheme] (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (ρ : CoherentFormalModule X I ⥤ CoherentFormalModule U.toScheme (I.comap U.ι))
    (hρ : ρ ⋙ (IsCoherentFormalModule (I.comap U.ι)).ι =
      (IsCoherentFormalModule I).ι ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ X.Modules U.toScheme.Modules).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)) :
    let T := formalAffineSectionTower X U (I.comap U.ι)
    let J := I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩
    ∃ θ : ∀ (G : CoherentModules X) (n : ℕ),
      (Γ(G.obj, U) ⧸ (J ^ (n + 1) • ⊤ : Submodule Γ(X, U) Γ(G.obj, U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
        (T.obj (ρ.obj ((completion X I).obj G))).obj (op n),
      (∀ (G : CoherentModules X) (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
        ((T.obj (ρ.obj ((completion X I).obj G))).map (homOfLE h).op).hom.comp
            (θ G m).toLinearMap =
          (θ G n).toLinearMap.comp
            (AdicCompletion.transitionMap J Γ(G.obj, U) (Nat.succ_le_succ h))) ∧
      (∀ (G H : CoherentModules X) (f : G ⟶ H) (n : ℕ),
        ((T.map (ρ.map ((completion X I).map f))).app (op n)).hom.comp
            (θ G n).toLinearMap =
          (θ H n).toLinearMap.comp
            (((f.hom.val.app (op U)).hom.reduceModIdeal (J ^ (n + 1))).restrictScalars
              Γ(X, U)))
